messages:
Maya (sales): Kicking off AcmeCorp POC on 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC. 6-week trial. Primary asks: EU-only data residency, SSO (SAML/AAD), 90-day query audit logs to their SIEM, p95 < 300ms target, semantic recall >= 0.85 on their eval set. Who can own infra, model onboarding, SSO, and monitoring?

Tyler (eng-platform): I can take infra + private deployment. Plan to spin up a dedicated staging cluster in eu-west1 and reserve GPUs for embedding + generation. Target staging ready by 2026-04-02 EOD if we have customer TLS certs and SSO metadata. Blockers: customer-issued certs and SSO XML. Need model pin/quant profile from Elena to size instances.

Elena (eng-ml): I'll own model onboarding and eval pipelines. Please upload their eval prompts + labels. I can run initial eval within 48h of data availability. Will propose two variants: fp16 baseline and int8-quantized. Need sample size for embedding vectors to estimate index memory.

Sam (solutions): Uploaded eval set + README here: https://acme.share/poceval — README lists expected labels and evaluation rubric. They expect vector search + rerank, chunking for long documents, and ~1M embeddings for trial index. Is that within typical POC sizing?

Tyler (eng-platform): 1M vectors is fine but requires tuned ANN settings (HNSW) and enough RAM for the index. Need embedding dimension and dtype to finalize instance sizes. Also decision point: persistent FAISS index (faster) vs ephemeral (cheaper). I'll draft cost/latency tradeoffs after Elena confirms embedding dim.

Jess (sales-ops): Milestone outline (for alignment):
- Week 0 (2026-04-07): Kickoff + environment access
- Week 1: SSO integration + basic smoke tests
- Week 2: Indexing + load tests
- Week 3-4: Model tuning + quality checks
- Week 6: Success review and go/no-go
Customer said Week 1 is a hard dependency for their internal stakeholders; any hard blockers now?

Maya (sales): Also need 90-day audit logs for queries and auth events forwarded to their SIEM. Can we push logs directly or do we need a connector?

Kiran (eng-sre): We can export logs via S3/GCS deliveries or stream to their SIEM via syslog/HTTP. I'll add an export pipeline and retention policy. Setting alerts: error rate > 0.5% (5m) and p95 latency > 350ms.

DeployBot: deploy scheduled to staging on 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC — bundle: models+infra — https://deploys.redwood/deploy/6789 :robot_face:

Tyler (eng-platform): @Kiran after staging is up can you run the synthetic workload (5m cadence) against the dedicated cluster? Also we need a short runbook to flip traffic to hosted fallback if the dedicated cluster exceeds SLOs.

Kiran (eng-sre): Will add synthetic checks + failover runbook. ETA runbook: 2026-04-03.

Elena (eng-ml): FYI: I opened PR #587 that tweaks KV cache eviction for long contexts; it's small but affects perf. @Mohit please review today so we can include it in the staging deploy.

Mohit (eng-runtime): Reviewing PR #587 now. I'll validate int8 and fp16 paths locally. Quick question: for the POC are we OK with int8 as default with fp16 rollback on quality issues?

Elena (eng-ml): Yes — int8 default for cost-efficiency, keep fp16 as fallback for any regressions.

Sam (solutions): Sent SSO metadata and service account details to #private-deals. Also shared sample prompts and labels in the drive.

Tyler (eng-platform): Blocking checklist I own:
- [ ] Customer TLS certs for EU gateway
- [ ] SSO metadata and test account
- [ ] Model pin/quant profile from Elena
- [ ] Finance sign-off on POC spend (cc @Jess)
If any missing by 2026-03-31, staging may slip.

Jess (sales-ops): I'll chase certs and SSO metadata today and follow up with finance for a fast approval.

Maya (sales): Request: eng owners post a one-line daily status here for the next 5 business days so we can update the customer PM.

Tyler (eng-platform): Daily 1-line (today): started infra provisioning; waiting on certs. :eyes:

Kiran (eng-sre): Daily 1-line (today): alert rules drafted; log export pipeline skeleton in place.

Elena (eng-ml): Daily 1-line (today): eval pipeline configured; PR #587 queued; waiting on full sample set.

Mohit (eng-runtime): Daily 1-line (today): running perf checks on int8; will review PR #587 this afternoon.

Sam (solutions): Daily 1-line (today): verified customer uploads and shared SSO metadata to private channel.

Maya (sales): Thanks — please ping when PR merged and when staging smoke tests pass. :rocket:

-- end of thread --
